summary: Master energy economics and the oil and gas market with our expert-led training course. Gain valuable insights and boost your career potential. Sign up now!
lede: Energy pricing training explains how supply, demand, market structure and policy shape oil and gas prices. It is for energy professionals such as analysts, traders, investors and decision-makers who need to interpret price movements and evaluate projects. The course covers comparing spot and futures markets, using forecasting and sensitivity analysis, and applying hedging and scenario planning to assess price risks and investment choices.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals whose roles intersect with economics, strategy, and investment in the energy sector, including:
audience: Oil and gas executives and decision-makers
Policy planners and regulators in energy ministries
Corporate strategists in utilities and energy firms
Consultants, researchers, and academics in energy policy
outcomes: Energy Policy And Regulatory Impact Assessment
modules: The Global Oil and Gas Market Landscape
Natural Gas and LNG Market Economics
Energy Project Evaluation and Investment Decisions
